label: Commands
description: Resolves executable Commands, validates their named arguments, and executes them through the Tasks service.

commandRunOptions.description: Options used to resolve and execute one Command.

id.description: Command identifier resolved through the command Loader.

args.description: Named Command arguments. Values are validated and ordered using the Command execute contract.

background.description: Whether the Task is globally visible and may continue independently of its initiating UI.

task.description: Stable live Task handle created by tasks.run(). It exposes Task observation, cancellation, output, wait, and result APIs.

run.description: Asynchronously loads a Command and validates its arguments before creating a Task. Resolves to the live Task handle; Command execution continues through that Task.

returns.description: A Promise resolving to the newly created live Task handle.
